plain_english: O Ender, turn not toward me this most wrathful-terrible gaze. Firm in Śaṅkara-service and contemplation, I am filled with terrifying Bhairava-power.
sanskrit_cite: antaka māṃ prati mā dṛśam enām | krodhakarālatamām vinidhehi śaṅkarasevana cintanadhīraḥ asmi bhīṣaṇabhairavaśaktimayo'smi
